topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The hallway seems longer now, the air a bit thinner. It’s strange how spaces can change when the things inside them do. The building, with its old, creaky floors and faded wallpaper, is becoming something else, something set in stone and contracts. I wander through the rooms, tracing the walls with my fingers, as if trying to hold onto the echoes of what once was. The familiar nooks and crannies, the late-night conversations in the stairwell, they all blur into a memory that’s slipping away, one floor at a time. It’s as if the place itself is taking a deep, quiet breath, preparing to exhale a new, different life.
